capabilities.body: I-OpenAmer ihlela umsebenzi, iwenze ngamathuluzi angempela — itheminali, isiphequluli, amafayela, ikhodi — bese igcina okusebenzile.
capabilities.title: Umenzeli ocabanga nawe

capabilities.body: Izingxoxo, inkumbulo namamodeli kuhlala kulo mshini. Akukho okulayishwayo ngaphandle kokuthi ukucele.
capabilities.title: Umshini wakho, idatha yakho

capabilities.body: Izilimi ezingu-186, ngayinye ngombhalo owufundayo. Isikrini sokuqala sohlelo sikubuza ukuthi ukhetha luphi.
capabilities.title: Ulimi lwakho, ngendlela efanele

capabilities.body: Amakhono agcinwa emsebenzini owenziwe, ngakho imisebenzi yansuku zonke ithatha isikhathi esincane njengoba uqhubeka nokulusebenzisa.
capabilities.title: Amandla akhulayo

help: Hlola ukuthi lo mshini uyakwazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi.
Phinda uqalise ukusetha — izinyathelo eziqediwe ngeke ziphindwe.
Uma kwehluleka kabili, vula amalogi; imigqa yokugcina isho isinyathelo.
failure.lead: Azikho izinguquko ezibuyiselwe emuva buthule — i-OpenAmer ima lapho ime khona, ukuze uma iphinda isebenza iqhubeke lapho.
failure.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer isasenguqulweni yangaphambilini futhi iyaqhubeka nokusebenza. Akukho okushintshwe kwashiywa phakathi.
failure.title: Ukusetha akuqedwanga

language.lead: Ukusetha kuqhubeka ngolimi olukhetha lapha. Ungalushintsha kamuva ohlelweni.
language.title: Khetha ulimi lwakho

progress.lead: Ukusetha kanye kuphela: I-OpenAmer ilanda ekudingayo futhi ilungiselela lo mshini. Uma ivulwa ngokuzayo, konke lokhu kuyeqiwa.
progress.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer ifaka inguqulo entsha esikhundleni seyangaphambilini. Amaseshini, inkumbulo nezilungiselelo zakho akuthintwa.
progress.title: Isetha i-OpenAmer

cards.body: Vula uhlelo bese uchaza ofuna kwenziwe. I-OpenAmer isebenza ngemuva bese ikubikela.
cards.title: Qala ngomusho

cards.body: Izilungiselelo → Ukubonisa → Ulimi. Izilungiselelo zolimi nezendawo ezingu-186, ungashintsha noma nini.
cards.title: Khetha ulimi lwakho

cards.body: Umsebenzi ophindaphindwayo uba yikhono — ngokuzayo udinga umyalo owodwa.
cards.title: Yivumele ikhumbule

success.lead: Konke sekumi ngomumo. I-OpenAmer manje ingeyakho — kulo mshini, ngolimi lwakho.
success.title: I-OpenAmer isilungile

bullets: Isebenza kulo mshini — izingxoxo zakho zihlala lapha
Konke kungashintshwa kamuva; akukho okuhlala unomphela
welcome.lead: Umenzeli wakho. Emshinini wakho. Ngolimi lwakho.
welcome.leadUpdate: Inguqulo entsha ye-OpenAmer isilungile. Ifakwa esikhundleni seyangaphambilini futhi igcina wonke amasesshini nezilungiselelo.
welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-OpenAmer
